title: PUT /api/v1/wifi/ap (request body)
description: Change the generated/custom AP SSID and open/WPA2 security. Timer must be open. Response is sent before the device restarts.

password.description: New WPA2 password: 8-63 printable ASCII. Ignored for open security, or when keep_password=true and a saved password exists. Omit or send empty to reuse that password. Write-only.

keep_password.description: When true and security='wpa2', preserves the existing WPA2 password while other fields are updated.

use_device_name.description: When true, restore the generated <hostname>-<chip-id> SSID and ignore any supplied 'ssid'.

standalone.description: When true, atomically clear saved station credentials and restart in AP Mode after responding.
